name: Tick Swarm

items.name: Cling
items.text:
Trigger A creature leaves the swarm's space

---

Effect The swarm takes 1d6 untyped damage as ticks cling to the creature and continue biting, dealing 3d6 bleed. Immersion in water reduces the DC of the flat check to end this persistent damage to 5, and any area damage dealt to the creature destroys these clinging ticks.

items.name: Swarming Bites
items.text: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d6 piercing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save save) plus Cling and exposure to tick fever.

items.name: Tick Fever
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 27 Fortitude save

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 Enfeebled 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 2 (1 day).

text: This swarm of thousands of fist-sized ticks forms a moving carpet of bloated insects-a nauseating and intimidating sight.
